s1d1: "Hacker becomes evil and forces you to do a task. You have 6 seconds to complete the task."
s2d1: - Hacker is replaced by Evil Hacker, who gives you a randomized task that you need to complete in under 6 seconds, otherwise you die.
s2d2: - The list of randomized tasks Evil Hacker can perform either requires you to Double Jump, Use your Ability, Bounce off a Cloud, Click on Evil Hacker's pop-up, Move in a certain direction, or Stop Moving.
s2d3: - HACKER SAYS! will appear in eviler curse selections after level 15.
